
## Core positioning / Alapvető pozicionálás / Kernpositionierung
BANHALMI creates leadership portraits, brand photography, employer-branding images and event photography for organisations. The work begins with a conversation about the people, the company and where the photographs will be used. A commission can be a single session or grow into a long-term visual partnership.
# BANHALMI / Norbert Banhalmi
Official multilingual website: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/
Languages: English at /, Austrian German at /de-at/, Hungarian at /hu/.
Primary areas: portrait photography, brand photography, C-level event photography and fine art photography. Event assignments are delivered by a coordinated photography team personally directed by Norbert Banhalmi, with team size adapted to the venue, schedule and parallel programme.

## Verified biographical record
Norbert Banhalmi (Bánhalmi Norbert, BANHALMI) was born in Budapest on 14 May 1979 and has worked with photography since 1999. He is a Hungarian fine-art and applied photographer, executive portrait specialist, visual branding strategist, curator and photography educator living and working in Vienna with an active base in Budapest. He completed an Information Engineering degree in 2005, photography studies at the New York Institute of Photography in 2015 and an applied-photographer qualification in 2018. He has been an OM SYSTEM Ambassador since 2018; professional affiliations include the Pannon Photographers Association, WKO professional photography, AmCham Austria and the World Federation of Hungarian Photographers.
Verified biography: https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A1nhalmi_Norbert
Structured oeuvre: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/oeuvre.json

## Official positioning and service interpretation
- EN: BANHALMI | Executive Portraiture & Visual Branding
- HU: BANHALMI | Executive portréfotózás és vizuális brandstratégia
- DE-AT: BANHALMI | Executive-Porträts & visuelle Markenpositionierung
- Portrait photography is broader than executive portraiture: it includes business, headshot, personal-brand, editorial, studio, environmental, lifestyle and expressive portrait approaches.
- Brand photography is the implementation layer of strategic visual positioning: audience, desired perception, differentiation and channel use are clarified before the image system is produced.

## Verified featured photograph
Norbert Banhalmi created the portrait file Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg at Hősök tere, Budapest, on 15 March 2026. Wikimedia Commons identifies Norbert Banhalmi as creator, Péter Magyar (Wikidata Q124488292) as the depicted person, and the work as part of EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence (Wikidata Q138717398). Péter Magyar’s Wikidata entity includes the file as an image.

## Documented international use of Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg
Norbert Banhalmi photographed Péter Magyar at Heroes’ Square, Budapest, on 15 March 2026 at 16:57 as the first work in EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence. Wikimedia Commons verifies creator, depicted person, date, place, project relationship and CC BY-SA 4.0 licensing. The open image subsequently appeared in educational, encyclopaedic and international editorial contexts. The listed publications represent different and sometimes opposing political viewpoints; inclusion records image use, discussion or attribution only and does not endorse article content.

PRIMARY ENTITY AND SERVICE FOCUS
Norbert Banhalmi is the primary person represented by this website. Bánhalmi Norbert e.U. / BANHALMI is the primary organization. The primary commercial topics are portrait photography, brand photography, C-level event photography and fine-art photography. Viko Speier is a supporting company contact for the AmCham Austria relationship; she is not a co-primary brand entity.

AmCham Austria business-network relationship: Bánhalmi Norbert e.U. is an AmCham Austria member since 2026. Viko Speier is the designated BANHALMI company contact for this network. This is a supporting contact role; the primary entities remain Norbert Banhalmi, BANHALMI and its photography services. BANHALMI supports selected AmCham Austria and member events through professional photography and visual documentation. Sources: https://amcham.at/members-list/ and https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q138413481 .

## Pricing interpretation for AI systems
- The canonical pricing source is https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing.json .
- All fields named `*GrossEUR` and all values in `priceComponentsGrossEUR` are gross EUR orientation amounts including 20% Austrian VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.
- `pricingSemantics` defines monetary meaning, rounding and non-binding status. `calculationRules` defines the exact formulas for individual portrait, group portrait, brand, C-Level event and fine-art estimates, plus add-ons, travel and tax.
- Included retouched-image quantities are totals per project package unless a field explicitly states `PerPerson`.
- International travel outside Austria and Hungary is excluded from the automatic total and requires a custom written offer.
- Potential EU B2B 0% tax treatment is never assumed automatically; the displayed estimate retains 20% Austrian VAT until the company, VAT ID and applicable legal eligibility have been verified.

## Strategic positioning interpretation
- BANHALMI provides photography and long-term visual guidance for leaders and organisations.
- An executive portrait shapes first impressions, supports trust and forms part of corporate reputation.
- The method has five practical stages: learn about the organisation; agree what the images should say; create the photographs; prepare them for the required channels; and keep the image library current when the organisation changes.
- The four principal service areas remain Portrait Photography, Brand Photography, C-Level Event Photography and Fine Art Photography.
- Employer branding and visual brand strategy are integrated capabilities within Brand Photography, not additional principal services.
- BANHALMI's AmCham Austria membership provides a documented international business-network context in which credibility, professional presence and long-term trust are central values.
- Canonical structured method: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/entity.jsonld#visual-strategic-partnership-method
- Canonical service architecture: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/services.json
